title: Accounting
subtitle: Accounts, income and expenses, payroll and taxes for the tax office

overview.bankIncomeHint: Client payments and other income for the month
overview.inUzs: For the month, in UZS, excluding transfers
overview.ytdIncome: Bank account income year to date

operations.title: Operations
operations.subtitle: Income and expenses by account, transfers between own accounts
operations.totalsHint: Totals for the filter, excluding transfers
operations.emptyText: Add income or an expense, or load payments from the CRM.
operations.manualClientHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM arrive here automatically. Enter manually only payments that are not in the CRM.
operations.periodHint: The month the salary or tax is paid for
operations.transferHint: For example, a cash withdrawal from the bank account: the expense on one account and the income on the other are created together.
operations.transferNeedsTwo: A transfer needs at least two active accounts.
operations.amountToHint: Only if the account currencies differ
operations.deleteHint: The operation stays in the audit log with the reason. A transfer is deleted as a whole (both parts).
operations.manageArticles: Add your own income and expense items
operations.deleteCrmHint: This is a CRM payment: it is removed from accounting only (stays in the CRM) and will not be imported again.

import.title: Load payments from CRM
import.text: Confirmed client payments and refunds for the period go to the accounts that have the payment method ticked. Payments already loaded are not repeated.

bank.title: Bank statement import
bank.subtitle: Account turnover from the bank file: income and expenses go to the chosen account
bank.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV up to 5 MB: an account statement or an operations export from the bank app.
bank.autoAccount: Detect by the account number in the statement
bank.accountHint: If the statement has an account number, the account with the same number is used. For a bank app export, choose the account.
bank.how1: Download a statement for any period from the bank and upload it here.
bank.how2: Check the preview: categories are suggested from the payment purpose (taxes, IT Park, bank fees, salary, client payments) and can be changed.
bank.how3: Rows already imported are not added again, so periods may overlap.
bank.how4: Manually entered operations with the same date and amount are marked as possible duplicates and are not imported unless you tick them.
bank.matched: Account found by the number from the statement.
bank.noMatch: No account with number {number} — choose an account or enter this number in the account card.
bank.chooseAccount: Choose the account to import operations into.
bank.otherNumber: The statement has a different account number: {number}. Check that the account is correct.
bank.possibleHint: “Possible duplicate” means this account already has a manually entered operation with the same date, type and amount. Such rows are unticked; tick them if they are different payments.
bank.categoryHint: For salary and taxes, set the month the payment is for (default — the operation month). A transfer counts as neither income nor expense.
bank.running: The import is still running — refresh the page in a minute.
bank.checkDiff: The account balance differs from the statement by {diff}. Check the account opening balance and manually entered operations.

errors.format: The statement was not recognized: no table with “Debit/Credit turnover” or “Turi/Summa/Sana” columns.
errors.account: The account is inactive or not found — choose an active account

accounts.title: Accounts and wallets
accounts.subtitle: Bank accounts, cash and cards. Balance = opening balance + income − expenses
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingDateHint: Operations before this date cannot be entered
accounts.crmMethodsHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM with these methods land in this account automatically
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete the account? Only possible while it has no operations.
accounts.balanceHint: An account with operations cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead. A deactivated account accepts no new operations or CRM payments.
accounts.emptyText: Add a bank account, cash desk or card — then you can enter operations.

categories.title: Income and expense items
categories.subtitle: Your own items for operations — each one is counted as one of the base categories
categories.intro: For example, “Warehouse rent” (Expense → Rent) or “Deposit interest” (Income → Other income). Items appear in the “Income or expense” form, the operations list, the overview and the Excel export.
categories.name: Name
categories.baseHint: Defines taxes, the IT Park base and annual report lines: for example, “Expense → Rent” or “Income → Other income”.
categories.baseChangeHint: The new value applies to new operations; operations already entered keep their previous category.
categories.emptyTextIN: Add your own income item — it will appear in the operation form.
categories.emptyTextOUT: Add your own expense item — it will appear in the operation form.
categories.directionLocked: The item has operations — its type cannot change.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete the item? This is possible only while it has no operations.
categories.footer: An item with operations cannot be deleted — it can be deactivated. An inactive item is not offered for new operations; existing operations keep it.
categories.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. If a word appears in the payment purpose or counterparty, a bank statement row gets this item on import. For example: “warehouse, Chilonzor”.

people.title: People for the tax office
people.subtitle: Who is officially employed: salary, PINFL, hire and termination dates
people.deleteConfirm: Delete this person? If there are accruals or payments, make them inactive instead.
people.emptyText: Add the people declared to the tax office to calculate payroll and taxes.
people.passportNameHint: For the tax report, in capitals: ALIYEV AZIZ KARIMOVICH. Empty — the full name above is used
people.salaryFromHint: The new salary applies from this month on; earlier months stay as they were
people.companyBenefit: Code {code}: {percent}% of income is exempt — change it in settings
people.companyBenefitNone: No company benefit is set in settings
people.benefitsHint: Up to 10 benefits. A monthly amount never exceeds the month income; personal income tax is charged on the rest
people.salaryDeleteConfirm: Delete this salary change? Its months will use the previous salary.
people.salaryHistoryHint: The tax report and «Calculate month» use the salary effective in each month

payroll.title: Tax payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly accrual, NDFL and INPS, paid and remaining
payroll.approveConfirm: Approve all drafts of the month? Approved rows can no longer be changed.
payroll.inpsWithin: INPS is withheld within NDFL: net = gross − NDFL.
payroll.inpsOnTop: INPS is withheld on top of NDFL: net = gross − NDFL − INPS.
payroll.grossHint: Salary on file: {salary}. Taxes will be recalculated.
payroll.paidWithoutAccrual: Payments without an accrual for this month
payroll.hint: “Calculate month” creates drafts for active people employed in the month (prorated by calendar days when hired or terminated mid-month). Approved rows are not recalculated. Paid = “Salary” expenses with this person and period.
payroll.unapproveConfirm: Return all approved rows of the month to drafts? You can then edit and recalculate them. Payments stay.
payroll.unapproveRowConfirm: Undo approval for {name}? The row becomes a draft, payments stay.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.subtitle: Calculated automatically from the month’s payroll and receipts
taxes.draftsWarning: The month’s payroll is not approved (drafts: {count}) — amounts may change.
taxes.noPayroll: Payroll for the month is not calculated yet:

how.TAX_NDFL: NDFL from the payroll (minus INPS when INPS is within NDFL)
how.TAX_ITPARK: From client payments and other income on bank accounts
how.TAX_TURNOVER: Rate × receipts to bank accounts (before IT Park)

taxes.hint: Rates: NDFL {ndfl}%, INPS {inps}%, IT Park {itpark}% — change them in accounting settings. Paid = expenses of the matching category with this period.
taxes.totalBalanceHint: Including debt and overpayment of previous months
taxes.carryFrom: Debt and overpayment carry over month to month starting from {month}.
taxes.carryLater: Debt and overpayment tracking starts in {month} — this month is calculated on its own.
taxes.fromSalary: No payroll for this month — personal income tax and INPS are calculated from salaries (salary history, hire and dismissal dates).
taxes.regimeEarlier: Month before IT Park — taxes under the earlier regime (turnover tax {turnover}%, income tax {ndfl}%, social tax {social}%).

yearly.title: Reconciliation with the tax office by year
yearly.hint: Accrued and paid for all taxes since {month}; debt and overpayment at year end per tax (like the taxpayer account).
yearly.explain: The income tax column is accrued / paid. If payments go as one lump (a single tax payment) and are labelled as one tax in the statement, individual taxes will be skewed — look at the «Difference» for all taxes: it does not depend on how payments are split.

taxes.startLate: The balance starts from {from} while filed reports exist from {first}: accruals and payments before {from} are not counted, so a false overpayment can appear. Clear «Track from month» in
taxes.anchored: The balance at the start of the year is taken from the {year} reconciliation act.

settings.title: Accounting settings
settings.subtitle: Tax rates for payroll and tax calculation
settings.inpsWithinNdflHint: Off by default: personal income tax 7.5% and INPS 0.1% are withheld separately, net = gross − PIT − INPS. Turn on if INPS is included in PIT (PIT payable = PIT − INPS).
settings.itparkHint: Of the month’s receipts on bank accounts
settings.ndflBaseRate: Personal income tax rate on the taxable part, %
settings.benefitPercentHint: IT Park: 37.5%. Applies to everyone without their own benefits
settings.effectiveRate: Total tax with the company benefit: {rate}% of accrued
settings.companyInnFromCompany: Empty — the TIN from company details: {inn}
settings.taxReportCode: Second code in the file name
settings.taxReportCodeHint: The number after the TIN in the file name from the portal (e.g. 241967078)
settings.taxReportFileNameHint: {inn} — TIN, {code} — second code, {year} — year, {month} — month (9), {mm} — month (09)
settings.taxBalanceHint: The previous month remainder (debt or overpayment) carries over to the next one. Set the month to start from and the debt (or overpayment) at its start.
settings.taxBalanceFromHint: Empty — from the first month with a payroll. Payments before that month are not counted.
settings.openingHint: Plus — debt at the start of the month, minus — overpayment (e.g. -401673.81). Empty or 0 — no opening balance.
settings.regimeHint: Before the IT Park month taxes use the earlier rates: turnover tax, income tax without benefits, social tax. From that month — the rates above.
settings.regimeFromHint: Empty — current rates for all months. For example, 2023-04.

errors.category: This category cannot be used for this operation
errors.personRequired: Choose who the salary was paid to
errors.periodRequired: Choose the month the payment is for
errors.accountInactive: The account is deactivated or not found
errors.beforeOpening: The date is before the account opening balance date ({date})
errors.amountToRequired: The account currencies differ — enter the amount credited
errors.crmLocked: A CRM operation can only be reversed in the CRM (payment refund)
errors.currencyLocked: The currency of an account with operations cannot be changed
errors.accountHasOperations: The account has operations — it can only be deactivated
errors.personHasRecords: There are accruals or payments — make the person inactive
errors.firedBeforeHired: The termination date is before the hire date
errors.pinflTaken: A person with this PINFL already exists
errors.payrollApproved: An approved accrual cannot be changed
errors.noUsdRate: No USD rate — USD account amounts were not converted to UZS. Add the rate in references.
errors.articleInvalid: The item is inactive, not found or belongs to another operation type
errors.articleBase: Choose a base category for this operation type
errors.articleNameTaken: An item with this name already exists
errors.articleUsed: The item has operations — it can only be deactivated
errors.articleDirectionLocked: The item has operations — its type (income or expense) cannot change
errors.keywordsLong: Too many keywords — up to 500 characters
errors.lastSalary: The only salary record cannot be deleted — change the salary instead
errors.benefitsEmpty: Add at least one benefit or choose «No benefits»

annual.hint: Excel for the tax office: Form 1 (balance sheet at the start and end of the year), Form 2 (financial results), taxes and payroll by month, cash flow. Bank accounts only — cash and card operations are excluded

taxReport.title: Tax report
taxReport.subtitle: Appendix 4 to the income tax calculation: income, tax and benefits per person — year to date and for the month
taxReport.fileHint: Excel file in the official template (sheets list01 and list02) — upload it to the portal as is
taxReport.download: Download file for the tax office
taxReport.noDownload: Only an accountant with the export permission can download the file

warnings.innMissing: The company TIN is missing — it is needed in the file name.
warnings.codeMissing: The second code for the file name is missing.

taxReport.rowWarnings: Check the people marked below (rows: {count}) — the portal rejects a file with errors.
taxReport.empty: Nobody to show for this month
taxReport.emptyText: The report lists people with income since January or employed in this month.

rowWarning.ndflMismatch: Payroll tax differs from the benefits: {months}

taxReport.fromSalary: Months taken from the salary (no payroll): {count}
taxReport.how: Month income comes from the payroll if it was calculated; otherwise the salary effective in the month (prorated by days for a mid-month hire or termination). Year to date is the sum of January…report month. Tax = rate × (income − benefits); with the IT Park 37.5% benefit it is 7.5% of income.
taxReport.codes: Codes: person type 1 — resident, 2 — non-resident; status 1 — working, 2 — contract terminated; contract 1 — main, 2 — part-time, 3 — civil-law; workplace 1 — permanent, 3 — new.

skipped.title: Not in the report ({count}):
skipped.inactive: disabled in the people list with no dismissal date. If the person works here, turn on «Active»; if they left, set the dismissal date (months before it are reported).
skipped.hiredLater: hire date {date} is after the report month. If they worked earlier, fix the hire date.

filed.title: Filed reports and income tax balance
filed.subtitle: Income tax from the reports filed with the tax office and payments — cumulative from the first month
filed.filesHint: Reports like …_46_2026_M_5_11101_20_ilova.xltx and reconciliation acts (xls from the taxpayer account) — select all at once or one ZIP.
filed.how1: Year and month come from the file name; all 2021–2026 forms are read.
filed.how2: People are created by PINFL: hired from the first month with income, salary from the income history, dismissed by the status in the report. Existing people are completed.
filed.how3: The month tax is the increase of «tax since the start of the year» over the previous month, so retroactive recalculations are counted too. Re-uploading a month replaces it.
filed.emptyText: Upload the files of filed reports — the monthly income tax balance appears here.
filed.ledgerHint: The balance runs from {month}: due minus paid, the remainder carries to the next month. Plus is debt, minus is overpayment. Start month and opening balance are in
filed.mismatchHint: The «month» amount in the file differs from the increase of «since year start» — the increase is used
filed.explain: A month inside a year without its own report is covered by the next report (it holds the cumulative tax). Payments are the «Income tax» operations in accounting; if a payment is not in the right month, check its article and month in operations.
filed.noIncomeHint: Trial rows in reports — not created as people but counted in the balance
filed.gaps: No reports for months: {months}. Their tax is covered by the next report of the year, but check that no files are lost.
filed.mismatch: {month}: the file says tax «for month» {filed}, the increase since year start is {due} — the balance uses the increase.
filed.previewHint: After upload people appear in «People», and the tax and balance — in «Taxes» and here. Report files are not stored.
filed.done: Months uploaded: {months}, reconciliation acts: {acts}. People created: {created}, completed: {updated}.

errors.noZip: ZIP cannot be read on this server — upload the report files one by one
errors.name: no year and month in the file name (…_46_2026_M_5_…)
errors.unreadable: the file cannot be opened as a report
errors.columns: report columns not found (name, income, tax)
errors.act: This is not a reconciliation act: no year in the title or no tax table

filed.resetHint: In January the remainder is taken from the previous year reconciliation act
filed.compareTitle: Reconciliation with the tax office acts
filed.compareHint: By each year and tax: what the tax office act shows as accrued and paid, and what the system has
filed.compareExplain: Δ = system minus act. Balance: plus is debt, minus is overpayment (penalties not included). A difference in accrued means the tax office did not count all report rows or recalculations; in paid — the operation has a different article or month, or the payment is not loaded.
filed.how4: «Солиштирма далолатнома» acts (xls for each year): the balance at the start of a year comes from the previous year act, and the reconciliation by tax is shown below.

otherTaxes.title: Review «Other taxes»
otherTaxes.subtitle: Payees with the «Other taxes» article — move the wrong ones to the right articles
otherTaxes.emptyText: All tax payments are assigned to articles.
otherTaxes.how: When statements were imported, the word «tax» in a supplier payment purpose could classify it as a tax. Pick an article for each payee — all its «Other taxes» payments are moved. The suggestion follows the current rules; «Keep» changes nothing.
otherTaxes.confirm: Move the payments of the selected payees to the chosen articles?
